insight.headline: NHR bypass ORN press trap with under-pressure line break at 72:12
insight.why_it_matters: ORN-06's press trap (e-000973, pressure 0.9) was designed to force NHR backwards from x=42.0, but NHR-08 completed a 24.6 m pass out of that pressure into NHR-14 at x=62.0. That single action converted a defensive engagement into forward progression and added 0.1736 expected threat, putting NHR into an attacking position where the next actions produced a shot on target. For ORN, the value of the trap is negated when the first pass out of it is completed under 0.82 pressure, because the pressing line is then behind the ball with NHR running at it.
insight.watch_next: Watch item only, not a confirmed pattern: the ORN press flagged as press_trap at e-000973 was beaten once here, and the subsequent e-000980 pass out of pressure 0.83 suggests monitoring whether ORN-06 and ORN-07 repeat the same engagement point or adjust their trigger.

claims.text: NHR-08 completed a 24.6 m pass from x=38.0 to x=62.0 while under pressure of 0.82, immediately after ORN-06 applied a 0.9 press trap at e-000973.
The break carried an event difficulty rating of 8.7 in the event data, the highest of the passes in this window, where the snapshot pass_difficulty average is 4.3786.
The receiver NHR-14 covered 26.0 m at 33.4 km/h and carried a further 14.0 m before shooting from x=78.0 at 104.2 km/h; the shot was saved, so the sequence created a big chance rather than a goal.
The action added 0.1736 threat to an NHR total of xt_home 20.6046, against xt_away 21.8865 in a match level at 1-1.
The break occurred in a window with aggregate chaos 0.8534 and pressure 0.5496, with control_home 0.6069 and control_away 0.6328 showing neither side holding a clear territorial advantage.

fan_cards.headline: NHR-08 sale de la trampa con un pase de 24,6 m bajo presión de 0,82

NHR-08 no retrocedió: aguantó, giró y filtró un pase de 24,6 m hasta NHR-14 en x=62,0, con 0,82 de presión encima. NHR-14 ya iba lanzado: 26,0 m a 33,4 km/h, 14,0 m más de conducción y disparo desde x=78,0 a 104,2 km/h. El portero lo salvó.

Protege el balón con el cuerpo, fija al pressor y suelta el pase al espacio que deja la línea rival, que ya queda detrás del balón. Ahí nace todo: tu pase rompe la presión y tu compañero llega corriendo a la frontal.
